title: After the Arima Kinen: Chasing Dreams

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin suffers a frustrating loss at the Arima Kinen, but her running captivates her family and friends, who praise her sheer determination.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And it's not just Ines's fans who are moved by the sight of her chasing her dreams. Oguri Cap—who was rumored to be retiring—is also inspired to hope again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines's running isn't a selfish act at all—it's the very embodiment of everyone's dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Realizing that it's okay for her to run as much as she wants, and to enjoy it too, Ines wells up. It's not long before her cheeks are glistening with warm tears.
